'''Hiram Drayson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], known as a military commander and intelligence administrator.

==Biography==
Drayson attended an offworld military academy, but returned home with his education incomplete when his father became ill. He took over his father's shipping business; under his leadership, it became the most successful such business in the [[Chandrila system/Legends|Chandrila system]]. Because of this and his partial Academy education, the Chandrilan government made him the head [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Chandrila Defense Fleet]]. He reorganized it to run more efficiently, cutting down [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] dramatically. It was in his capacity as fleet commander that he came to know [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="DFRSB" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Admiral Drayson was replaced as fleet head by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]-appointed [[Kohl Seerdon]] after the passage of [[Reflex Amendment/Legends|Emergency Amendment 121b]].<ref name="Insider" /> At some point in his career, he gained extensive experience serving aboard [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], including a professional knowledge of their [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] systems.

When Chandrila was brought to heel under the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]], Drayson was contacted by Mon Mothma, who offered Admiral Drayson a role in the military leadership of the new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as the commanding officer of the Alliance flagship. He accepted.<ref name="DFRSB" />

As the Alliance transitioned into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Admiral Drayson commanded the [[New Republic Second Fleet]] prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Drayson was later placed in command of [[New Republic First Fleet|the fleet]] attached to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]], and then of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] defense fleet.<ref name="DFRSB" /> He was tasked with the retrieval of the [[Katana fleet]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> As a military commander, Drayson was considered competent but not very creative, which left him rather outmatched when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] carried out an elaborate [[Siege of Coruscant|attack]] against Coruscant. His intense personal loyalty to Mon Mothma also led to some friction with [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], as he felt the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[General/Legends|General]] had betrayed Mothma by splitting away from the Rebel Alliance years earlier.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> Later, Drayson's command experience, strategic mind and extensive contacts made him the ideal candidate for first Director of [[Alpha Blue]], and Mon Mothma appointed him under decree [[D9020616]].<ref name="BtS" />

After decades of service in the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] apparatus, years that earned him the nickname "the Old Ghost of Coruscant,"<ref name="BtS" /> Drayson retired from service following [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s [[New Republic Presidential election, 23 ABY|election]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> He was married to [[Joi Eicroth]] for a time.<ref name="HT" /> He had a daughter, [[Bhindi Drayson]], who also served in New Republic Intelligence, as well as [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="RD" />

==Behind the Scenes==
The ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'' establishes that Drayson was 46 during the events of ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', which are dated to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Therefore, Drayson must have been born in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]. Yet, with the mentioning him as an admiral in {{InsiderCite|71|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:10:03}} set in [[21 BBY]]. When the birth date in the [[West End Games]] sourcebook is valid, he would be 16 years old at that point, which makes it questionable that he is already an admiral at that age. So it is rather questionable, that the birth date given by the sourcebook is still valid.
